spec.prompt: Refactor: move the tree pretty-printer (prettyPrintTimeTree) out of lib/time-tree.js into its own module lib/pretty-print.js, exported as a named function, and have TimeTree use it. Output must not change.
spec.requirement: lib/pretty-print.js exports { prettyPrintTimeTree } taking a TimeTree JSON node (and optional prefix) and returning exactly the string TimeTree#prettyPrint returned before. lib/time-tree.js no longer defines its own copy and uses the new module; TimeTree#prettyPrint and app.prettyPrint output are unchanged byte for byte.
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: require('lib/pretty-print').prettyPrintTimeTree(tree.toJSON()) equals tree.prettyPrint() and the known output for a nested tree
TimeTree#prettyPrint renders through lib/pretty-print (replacing that module changes its output)
lib/time-tree.js no longer defines its own prettyPrintTimeTree (as a declaration, function expression or arrow function)
